name: amba-lifestyle-backend
description: Backend API for Amba Lifestyle E-commerce Platform

scripts.clean-port: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{const out=execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :5005',{encoding:'utf8'});out.trim().split('\n').forEach(l=>{const p=l.trim().split(/\s+/);const pid=p[p.length-1];if(pid&&pid!=='0'&&pid!=process.pid)try{execSync('taskkill /F /PID '+pid,{stdio:'ignore'});console.log('Freed port 5005 (killed PID '+pid+')')}catch(_){}})}catch(_){console.log('Port 5005 already free')}"
